# Weekend Travellers - Full Documentation

> Weekend Travellers is an advanced AI-powered travel planner that generates customized 2-day to 3-day weekend itineraries, curated travel guides, and road trips.

## System Architecture

### Frontend (Next.js App Router)
- **Framework:** Next.js (App Router paradigm) with React and TypeScript.
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS with custom classes, gradients, and glassmorphism.
- **Animation:** Framer Motion for micro-interactions, page transitions, and smooth scroll effects.
- **UI Components:** Lucide React icons, Sonner toast notifications, custom-built modular components.

### Backend (Node.js/Express)
- **Framework:** Express.js with TypeScript in the `/backend` directory.
- **Database:** MongoDB and Mongoose schemas (`User`, `Trip`, `Blog`).
- **Authentication:** JWT (JSON Web Tokens) with authentication middleware.
- **AI Integration:** Service layer dedicated to dynamically generating itineraries.

## Core Features & AI Tools

- [AI Weekend Travel Planner](https://weekendtravellers.com/chat): Interactive AI chat assistant for generating custom 2-3 day weekend itineraries with hotels, budgets, and activities.
- [Inspiration Trips](https://weekendtravellers.com/inspiration-trip): Curated visual inspiration and theme-based getaway recommendations for quick weekend trips.
- [Smart Search](https://weekendtravellers.com/search): Search destinations, activities, and budget-friendly weekend getaways.

## Destinations & Travel Guides

- [Explore All Destinations](https://weekendtravellers.com/explore): Hand-curated weekend travel guides covering India, Europe, Asia, and top global getaways.
- [India Weekend Getaways](https://weekendtravellers.com/explore/india): Detailed guides for Goa, Rajasthan, Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, and top Indian weekend trips.
- [International Escapes](https://weekendtravellers.com/explore/europe): Curated 2-3 day itineraries for Europe, Thailand, Bali, Dubai, and Japan.
